title: Argmax of a List under a Total Preorder
body_html:
Argmax of a List under a Total Preorder

For a function f : α → β valued in a TotalPreorder β and a non-empty list head :: tail : List α, some element of the list maximizes f: $$ \exists m \in \operatorname{head} :: \operatorname{tail},\; \forall x \in \operatorname{head} :: \operatorname{tail},\; f(x) \le f(m). $$

The proof is by induction on tail, comparing the current maximum against the new head via TotalPreorder.le_total.

From the existence statement a noncomputable choice List.argMaxOn f head tail picks a witnessing maximizer. Its API:

  • argMaxOn_mem -- the chosen element lies in the list.
  • argMaxOn_ge -- the chosen element is ≥ every list element in f-value.
  • le_argMaxOn_head -- specialization: the head's value is ≤ the chosen element's value.

The variant exists because Mathlib's List.argmax is computable but requires [LinearOrder], which is too strong for ranking outcomes that may be indifferent (the typical situation when a player's payoffs are equal across distinct continuations). The intended consumer is ExtensiveGame.BackwardInduction, where finite game trees are evaluated by recursively picking an argmax of children.

References

  • [MSZ, Chapter 3] Maschler, Solan, and Zamir, Game Theory. Backward induction on finite extensive games.

lean_refs.name: List.exists_argMax_on
lean_refs.signature:
theorem exists_argMax_on [TotalPreorder Y] (f : X → Y)
    (head : X) (tail : List X) :
    ∃ m, m ∈ head :: tail ∧ ∀ x ∈ head :: tail, f x ≤ f m

lean_refs.name: List.argMaxOn
lean_refs.signature:
def argMaxOn [TotalPreorder Y] [DecidableLE Y] (f : X → Y)
    (head : X) (tail : List X) : X

lean_refs.name: List.argMaxOn_mem
lean_refs.signature:
theorem argMaxOn_mem [TotalPreorder Y] [DecidableLE Y] (f : X → Y)
    (head : X) (tail : List X) :
    argMaxOn f head tail ∈ head :: tail
lean_refs.docstring: The chosen maximizer is a member of the list.

lean_refs.name: List.argMaxOn_ge
lean_refs.signature:
theorem argMaxOn_ge [TotalPreorder Y] [DecidableLE Y] (f : X → Y)
    (head : X) (tail : List X) :
    ∀ x ∈ head :: tail, f x ≤ f (argMaxOn f head tail)
lean_refs.docstring: Soundness: every element's `f`-image is `≤` the chosen maximizer's.

lean_refs.name: List.le_argMaxOn_head
lean_refs.signature:
theorem le_argMaxOn_head [TotalPreorder Y] [DecidableLE Y] (f : X → Y)
    (head : X) (tail : List X) :
    f head ≤ f (argMaxOn f head tail)
lean_refs.docstring: The argmax achieves at least the head's value.
